app.title: cambio Tarif-Check
app.subtitle: Find out which cambio tariff would have been the cheapest for your trips.

footer.disclaimer: Not an official offer from cambio

dropzone.title: Drop your trip export here
dropzone.hint: or choose files – CSV or Excel (.xlsx), several at once

privacy.title: Your data stays with you
privacy.text: The analysis runs entirely in your browser. Your trips are neither uploaded nor stored.

where.title: Where do I get the export?
where.text: You can find the export in the cambio customer portal under “Fahrtenarchiv” (trip archive). Pick the period you want there and download the table as CSV or Excel.

import.completeness: The analysis is only correct if the export contains all trips of the period – including those of any additional drivers.

reasons.end-before-start: Booking end is before its start
reasons.before-price-data: Trip is older than the stored prices

errors.unsupported: This file type or table is not supported. Please use a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file from the trip archive.
errors.unreadable: The file could not be read. It may be damaged or structured differently than expected.
errors.too-large: The file is larger than 5 MB and was not read.

import.skipped: Skipped – the columns were not mapped.

mapping.title: Map columns
mapping.description: Not all columns in “{{file}}” could be recognised. Choose the matching column for each field.
mapping.ambiguous: Several columns match – please pick one.

summary.title: Imported trips
summary.driversHint_one: The export contains {{count, number}} other driver. It has been entered as an additional driver in the settings.
summary.driversHint_other: The export contains {{count, number}} other drivers. They have been entered as additional drivers in the settings.
summary.confirmText: All imported trips and settings are removed from the browser. Your files stay untouched.

headline.saving: With the {{tariff}} tariff you would have saved {{amount}}.
headline.alreadyBest: You were in the cheapest tariff the whole time: {{tariff}}.
headline.switchingWon: Thanks to your switches you paid {{amount}} less than in the best single tariff ({{tariff}}).
headline.cheaperThanBest: You paid {{amount}} less than in the best single tariff ({{tariff}}).
headline.equal: You paid exactly as much as in the best single tariff ({{tariff}}).

sub.saving: You paid {{actual}}. With {{tariff}}, the same trips would have cost {{best}}.
sub.alreadyBest: No other tariff would have been cheaper for your trips. By these numbers, switching does not pay off.
sub.switchingWon: No single tariff would have been cheaper over the whole period than what you actually did.
sub.cheaperThanBest: No single tariff would have been cheaper over the whole period than what you actually paid.
sub.equal: A single tariff would not have saved you anything on these trips.
sub.alreadyBestHindsight: No other single tariff would have been cheaper. In hindsight, switching between tariffs would have saved {{hindsight}} – but you cannot know the month in advance.

optimal.label: Optimal in hindsight, {{switches}}
optimal.note: you cannot know the month in advance

summary.verification_one: {{exact, number}} of {{count, number}} trip recomputed to the cent
summary.verification_other: {{exact, number}} of {{count, number}} trips recomputed to the cent

verificationParts.verified-rounding_one: {{count, number}} with a 1 cent rounding difference
verificationParts.verified-rounding_other: {{count, number}} with a 1 cent rounding difference

summary.verificationHint: For every trip, the booking is reconstructed from the billed amount and recomputed with the stored prices. Only trips whose amount comes out exactly count as recomputed to the cent – not those with a 1 cent rounding difference, estimated ones or ones completed by hand.

warnings.title: Notes
warnings.open_one: {{count, number}} trip could not be recomputed unambiguously. You can enter its booked end in the trip list.
warnings.open_other: {{count, number}} trips could not be recomputed unambiguously. You can enter their booked end in the trip list.
warnings.surcharge_one: For {{count, number}} trip, the fuel surcharge was derived from the billed distance amount.
warnings.surcharge_other: For {{count, number}} trips, the fuel surcharge was derived from the billed distance amount.
warnings.mixed: In {{months}}, trips were billed in more than one tariff. Your tariff is taken from the month's last trip.
warnings.inherited: There were no trips in {{months}}. The previous month's tariff is assumed – you can change it in the table.

settings.title: Your details
settings.under26Hint: The Campus tariff is only available without additional drivers.

matrix.title: Month by month
matrix.intro: What each tariff would have cost for your trips, including the monthly fee.
matrix.caption: Cost per tariff and month in euros, including the monthly fee, plus your actual cost and tariff per month.

legend.title: Legend
legend.path: Optimal path in hindsight (with switching fees)

sourceHint.inherited: No trip this month. The previous month's tariff is assumed.
sourceHint.mixed: Trips billed in more than one tariff; the last trip's tariff counts.

chart.title: Monthly cost over time
chart.note: All values are also in the “Month by month” table.

breakEven.title: When does which tariff pay off?
breakEven.intro: From these monthly trip costs on, the pricier tariff makes up for its higher monthly fee through lower prices – based on your trips.
breakEven.pays: {{higher}} pays off compared with {{lower}} from {{amount}} of trip cost per month (at {{lower}} prices).
breakEven.never: {{higher}} never pays off compared with {{lower}} for your trips: its prices are not low enough to make up for the fee.
breakEven.months: {{count, number}} of {{total, number}} months were above

trips.title: Your trips
trips.intro: By month, newest first. For every trip: what was billed and what it would have cost in each tariff.
trips.deviationHint: Difference between the recomputed and the billed amount in the trip's tariff

verified.label: recomputed
verified.text: With the stored prices, the trip costs exactly the billed amount, to the cent.

verified-rounding.label: recomputed (1 cent rounding)
verified-rounding.text: The recomputation differs by one cent only – a matter of rounding.

estimated.label: estimated
estimated.text: Several booked ends match the amount; the earliest one is used. If you know the booked end, enter it.

manual.label: added by hand
manual.text: The booked end you entered is used.

cancelled.label: cancelled at short notice (50 %)
cancelled.text: The booking was cancelled at short notice; half of the time price is charged.

unused.label: not started (100 %)
unused.text: The booking was not used; the full time price is charged.

not-reproducible.label: not reproducible
not-reproducible.text: No booked end yields the billed amount. The trip is priced up to the return; enter the booked end if you know it.

bookedEnd.title: Booked end
bookedEnd.description: Until when was the trip booked? No earlier than {{time}} (the return, rounded up to the quarter hour).
bookedEnd.tooEarly: The booked end cannot be before {{time}}.
bookedEnd.invalid: This date does not exist. Please choose a valid date.
bookedEnd.tooLate: The booked end can be at most 30 days after the trip start, so {{time}} at the latest.

empty.title: No result possible
empty.period: There are no trips in the chosen period.
empty.tariffs: No tariff can price all of your trips.
